_comment: USER frame, 2026-10-06 (play viewer, Hinata2 seed 5 gi=4 T6, logs/play/rejections/
Hinata2_cod_s5_gi4_t6.json) -- the residual of the Spasm/Sol Ring fix: with no land drop,
Board: floating {U}, ONE untapped Island, two Forbidden Orchards + Izzet Boilerworks TAPPED,
Hinata out. Spasm (X=4, {U}{U} under Hinata) untaps all four lands: Island {U}, Boilerworks
{U}{R}, two Orchards (any colour) = 5 mana. Crackle X=1 at one target ({3}{R}{R} - 1 =
{2}{R}{R}) + Preordain {U} = 5: exactly payable, but only if Crackle's generic leaves a {U}.
HAND ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING: Crackle and Preordain tie at generic cast rank 20, so the
sequential-payability walk pays them in candidate (hand) order -- Crackle first, as in the real
frame. With Preordain first the walk pays it off Boilerworks and never hits the defect.
ROOT CAUSE: during a payment g_line_unpaid_cost still includes the cast being paid. Crackle's
{R}{R} were settled first (Boilerworks -> {R} + floating {U}; Orchard -> {R}); its generic pips
then read the line as still owing {R}{R} (Crackle's OWN, already paid). LineDemandAnyPipColor
tapped the last Orchard for that phantom {R}, and ConsumeFloatingAny's surplus order spent the
floating {U} (surplus 0) ahead of the {R} (surplus -1): Preordain's {U} unpayable. Fix: the
generic-pip readers of the line hold subtract the payment's own coloured pips
(g_pay_own_line_pips / LineOwedAfterOwnPips, the definition the line-float hold already used).
Discriminating: 'unsupported' on the pre-fix binary, 'accept' with the fix.
